findings.summary: R3 audit events are only appended to an in-process Python list (get_audit_log is consumed solely by tests): no persistence, no log emission, and no production readout path exists, so in the real 5602 service the off-mode 'would_deny' data — which the spec names as this ticket's core deliverable — is unobservable and unrecoverable, contradicting '每次拒绝（及 off 时的每次「本应拒绝」）必须可观测'.

[RESERVED-PATH REDIRECTED] Red-first evidence is missing: .dd-evidence/<attempt_id>/h7-scope.md only tabulates '必红' labels and a green summary (1426 passed) without any red-side run transcript, and never names per-assertion which assertion was red for cases 2/3/4/5/6/7 on the base, as required by spec §3 and §6 item 1 ('红在哪个断言逐条点名').

Mutation evidence (cases 8/9) is not delivered: no mutated-run echo exists, and test 8 simulates the mutation by swapping in a hand-written allow-by-default fake instead of mutating the real guard, so the required demonstration '用例 3 必须转红' is never actually produced; it validates the mock, not test 3's sensitivity (spec §3 cases 8/9, §6 item 2).

[RESERVED-PATH REDIRECTED] The required 'production form has no scope judgment' echo is a prose assertion of module absence at an unrelated commit (557e2ed8...), not the run transcript of the production-form harness the spec mandates ('该回显由 implementer 在其工装内构造').

The R2 gray switch is a module-level global with no operator-facing knob (env/config/endpoint); toggling requires in-process intervention. Default off, no auto-upgrade, and read-face/scopes.py non-goals are respected, so this is noted rather than enforced.
